comparison.objective: Place masonry units to form the next running-bond course; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-part grasping, mortar-course alignment, offset placement, and release versus precise hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, tightening, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: A correctly offset running-bond course is implied; candidate requires two safe repeated stops within stroke and drift constraints. Bond tolerances and stability rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Construction layout and placement do not exercise adjustable damping or cyclic performance validation.
